name: GL Tie-Out Recompute
outcome: Core Verify pack, chain 3 of 3 (CORE-VERIFY-BUILD-SPEC.md §6): independently ties a caller-declared reported figure to a caller-declared general-ledger figure, by account, using the existing report-to-GL reconciliation node (art-526) -- no new kernel, no new node. This is internal-control arithmetic, not a regulatory recompute: a general-ledger tie-out is a pure accounting identity (reported total must equal the GL total, net of any declared plug), not a rule stated by any external standard, so this chain carries no regulatory citation by design (see regulatory_basis_status below). The same node also serves the pack's core-conversion-balancing use (CORE-VERIFY-BUILD-SPEC.md §7): running it once with a legacy-core export as the 'reported' side and a new-core export as the 'gl' side, over the same period and account scope, produces a symmetric two-source diff with no 'correct' side asserted -- a caller-side framing choice, not a second code path.
